headline: Oncoclínicas Obtains Majority Creditor Approval for Extrajudicial Recovery
summary: Brazilian healthcare provider Oncoclínicas announced that its updated extrajudicial recovery plan reached the required quorum, with adherence exceeding 50% of total covered debt. The company will proceed to judicial ratification.
why: Oncoclínicas is one of Brazil's largest private oncology networks, listed on the B3 stock exchange.
